name: Global Orthogonal Sum
description: Replaced a local adversarial game constraint with a global sum over inner products of orthogonal vectors. Since the vectors are orthogonal but not normalized, their dot products are strictly non-negative (either 0 or 4). The global sum is exactly 0 if and only if every individual dot product is 0, which enforces that adjacent vertices have different colors. Models that pattern-match the global sum will evaluate it at the leaves of the search tree and TLE. Models that genuinely reason mathematically will deduce the local inequality and optimize the backtracking.
